sloka: स्वरेण वर्चसा च एव प्रेक्षितेन च वानर ।विक्रमेण च वाक्यैः च व्यक्तिम् वाम् न उपलक्षये ॥४-१२-३१॥
transliteration: svareṇa varcasā ca eva prekṣitena ca vānara ।vikrameṇa ca vākyaiḥ ca vyaktim vām na upalakṣaye ॥4-12-31॥

translations.english: 'O monkey in your voice, in brightness, in looks, in valour or in words I have marked no difference between you.
